objects.description: One versioned codebase. Everything else in this module hangs off a repository, directly or through a branch.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key for this repository.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The human-readable repository name, unique enough in practice that callers look a repository up by it.

fields.name: description
fields.description: What this repository holds, in the words of whoever created it.

fields.name: default_branch
fields.description: The name of the branch a caller gets when it names none. Set at creation and never empty afterwards.

fields.name: bare_clone_path
fields.description: Filesystem path of the bare shallow clone lazy import writes, reused when a branch is fetched on demand and when a blob's content is hydrated. Local to the process that imported, so it is never part of an API response.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: The remote HTTPS URL this repository was imported from. Empty for one created locally.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the repository was created.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When the repository was last changed.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Whether the repository has been removed from view.

objects.description: A named, mutable ref pointing at a commit. One branch per task in the task-branch workflow, deleted once its work is merged.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key for this branch.

fields.name: repository_id
fields.description: The repository this branch belongs to.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The ref name, such as "main" or "task/abc123".

fields.name: is_default
fields.description: Whether this is the repository's default branch.

fields.name: head_commit_id
fields.description: The commit at the branch tip. Advanced under a compare-and-set on every push and merge, so two concurrent writers cannot both win.

fields.name: sha
fields.description: The git hash at the branch tip, held beside the head commit so a caller reads the tip without a second lookup.

fields.name: status
fields.description: How much of this branch has actually been fetched, for a repository imported lazily: "stub" (known but not fetched), "fetching", "fetched", "fetch_failed". Empty for a branch created directly, which is fetched by definition. Deliberately not an enum, because empty is the ordinary case and an enum would refuse it.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: The remote URL a stub branch is fetched from. Empty once fetched and for a branch created directly.

fields.name: error_message
fields.description: Why the last fetch of this branch failed. Empty otherwise.

fields.name: workflow_run_id
fields.description: The orchestrated run that created this branch, so a rollback can find every branch one run produced. Empty for a branch created outside any run.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the branch was created.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When the branch tip last moved.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Whether the branch has been removed from view.

objects.description: An immutable commit. Content-addressed by sha and never changed after it is written.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key for this commit.

fields.name: repository_id
fields.description: The repository this commit was indexed into.

fields.name: sha
fields.description: The full 40-character hex commit hash. Deliberately NOT unique: the same content is legitimately re-materialised by more than one write path, and the same bytes are shared across repositories the way a fork shares objects on a real git host.

fields.name: message
fields.description: The commit message as git stores it.

fields.name: author_name
fields.description: Who wrote the change.

fields.name: author_email
fields.description: The author's email as git recorded it.

fields.name: author_at
fields.description: When the change was written.

fields.name: committer_name
fields.description: Who applied the change, which differs from the author after a rebase or a cherry-pick.

fields.name: committer_email
fields.description: The committer's email as git recorded it.

fields.name: committed_at
fields.description: When the change was applied.

fields.name: tree_id
fields.description: The root tree this commit points at. Empty where the tree was never indexed, which is what the history walk tests for before it descends.

fields.name: data
fields.description: The raw git commit object, base64-encoded. Written only where this module built the object itself; empty for a commit indexed from a clone, which never re-encodes what git already has.

fields.name: size
fields.description: Byte size of the raw commit object.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When this commit was indexed.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Whether the commit has been removed from view.

objects.description: One link from a commit to one of its parents. A commit walk that does not write these leaves the history it just indexed unreachable, because history is resolved solely through this table.

fields.name: commit_id
fields.description: The child commit.

fields.name: parent_id
fields.description: One of its parents.

fields.name: parent_index
fields.description: Git's own parent order: 0 is the first parent, 1 and up are merge parents. Held explicitly so a merge parent is never mistaken for a first parent, which it would be if the order fell out of insertion order.

objects.description: An immutable directory listing at one point in time. The root tree of a commit, or a nested subdirectory of one.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key for this tree.

fields.name: sha
fields.description: The full 40-character hex tree hash. Not unique, for the same reason a commit's is not.

fields.name: path
fields.description: The directory path within the commit's hierarchy. Empty denotes the root tree.

fields.name: entries
fields.description: The child entries as git lists them, each with a name, a mode and a sha.

fields.name: data
fields.description: The raw git tree object, base64-encoded. Written only where this module built the object itself.

fields.name: size
fields.description: Byte size of the raw tree object.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When this tree was indexed.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Whether the tree has been removed from view.

objects.description: One file directly inside one tree. Many-to-many, because identical content is reachable from more than one tree.

fields.name: tree_id
fields.description: The directory.

fields.name: blob_id
fields.description: The file inside it.

objects.description: One directory nested directly inside another.

fields.name: tree_id
fields.description: The containing directory.

fields.name: subtree_id
fields.description: The directory inside it.

objects.description: An immutable file content. Content-addressed by sha, so identical bytes at the same path are one row however many trees reach it.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key for this blob.

fields.name: sha
fields.description: The full 40-character hex blob hash. Not unique: the same bytes legitimately sit at more than one path, so a row is identified by sha and path together.

fields.name: path
fields.description: The file path from the repository root, such as "src/handlers/server.go".

fields.name: name
fields.description: The base file name including its extension.

fields.name: extension
fields.description: The file extension with no leading dot.

fields.name: size
fields.description: Byte size of the file content.

fields.name: encoding
fields.description: "utf-8" for text, "base64" for binary. Says how to read the content field.

fields.name: content
fields.description: The file content, base64-encoded where the encoding says so. Empty until hydrated, for a repository imported lazily.

fields.name: data
fields.description: The raw git blob object, base64-encoded. Written only where this module built the object itself.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When this blob was indexed.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Whether the blob has been removed from view.

objects.description: An immutable named ref pointing at a commit. Once written, what it points at must never change.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key for this tag.

fields.name: repository_id
fields.description: The repository this tag belongs to.

fields.name: commit_id
fields.description: The commit this tag resolves to, where that commit is indexed.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The tag name, such as "v1.2.0".

fields.name: sha
fields.description: The commit hash this tag resolves to, held whether or not the commit itself is indexed.

fields.name: message
fields.description: The annotation on an annotated tag. Empty for a lightweight one.

fields.name: tagger_name
fields.description: Who created an annotated tag.

fields.name: tagger_at
fields.description: When an annotated tag was created.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When this tag was recorded.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Whether the tag has been removed from view.

objects.description: A request to merge one branch into another, and the record of what happened to it.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key for this merge request.

fields.name: repository_id
fields.description: The repository both branches belong to.

fields.name: source_branch_id
fields.description: The branch whose work is being merged.

fields.name: target_branch_id
fields.description: The branch it is being merged into. Falls back to the repository's default branch where the caller names none, and always names a real branch once written.

fields.name: title
fields.description: A one-line summary of the change.

fields.name: description
fields.description: What the change does, at whatever length its author wanted.

fields.name: source_branch_name
fields.description: The source branch's name as it read when the request was opened, so the record still means something after the branch is deleted.

fields.name: target_branch_name
fields.description: The target branch's name as it read when the request was opened.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Where this request has got to.

fields.name: merged_commit_sha
fields.description: The target branch's new tip once the merge succeeded. Empty until then.

fields.name: author_name
fields.description: Who opened the request.

fields.name: error_message
fields.description: Why the merge failed. Empty unless the status says it did.

fields.name: workflow_run_id
fields.description: The orchestrated run that opened this request, so a rollback can find every request one run produced. Empty for one opened by hand.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the request was opened.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When the request last changed.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Whether the request has been removed from view.

objects.description: One label in a free-form taxonomy used to tag files. Keywords form a tree, and asking for a parent reaches its descendants.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key for this keyword.

fields.name: parent_id
fields.description: The keyword above this one. Empty for a root keyword, which is what a list of roots filters on.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The label itself.

fields.name: description
fields.description: What this label is for, so two people tag the same way.

fields.name: scope
fields.description: An optional grouping for the label, such as "domain", "layer" or "technology".

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the keyword was created.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When the keyword last changed.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Whether the keyword has been removed from view.

objects.description: Records that one file carries one keyword, on one branch. Branch-scoped, so the tagging follows the work: replicated when a branch merges and dropped when it is deleted.

fields.name: branch_id
fields.description: The branch this tagging holds on.

fields.name: blob_id
fields.description: The file being tagged.

fields.name: keyword_id
fields.description: The label it carries.

fields.name: signal
fields.description: How deeply this file covers the keyword, ranked when results are ordered: "surface", "index", "structural", "contributor", "authority". Deliberately not an enum, because an unrecognised value ranks last rather than being refused, and that tolerance is the existing behaviour.

fields.name: note
fields.description: Why this file was tagged, in the tagger's words.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the tagging was made.

objects.description: One named relationship between two files, on one branch. A fixed shape with both ends typed, not a generic edge: it cannot express a link between anything else.

fields.name: branch_id
fields.description: The branch this relationship holds on.

fields.name: from_blob_id
fields.description: The file the relationship points from.

fields.name: name
fields.description: What the relationship means. Both directions of a pair are stored as separate rows, so a lookup from either end is a plain indexed query.

fields.name: to_blob_id
fields.description: The file the relationship points to.

fields.name: descriptor
fields.description: What this particular link is about, where the name alone does not say.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the relationship was recorded.

objects.description: The state of one asynchronous import of a remote repository.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key for this job.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name the imported repository is to be given.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: The public HTTPS URL being cloned. No credentials are accepted, so a private repository cannot be imported this way.

fields.name: default_branch
fields.description: Which branch of the remote to mark as the default.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Where this import has got to.

fields.name: error_message
fields.description: Why the import failed. Empty unless the status says it did.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the import was requested.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When the job last changed.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Whether the job has been removed from view.

objects.description: The state of one asynchronous on-demand fetch of a single branch, for a repository that was imported without its full history.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key for this job.

fields.name: repo_id
fields.description: The repository whose branch is being fetched.

fields.name: branch_name
fields.description: Which branch to fetch.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Where this fetch has got to.

fields.name: error_message
fields.description: Why the fetch failed. Empty unless the status says it did.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the fetch was requested.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When the job last changed.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Whether the job has been removed from view.
